title: Price check
description: Estimate what a plan costs without storing anything. Charging usage and reserving funds move or hold money on a wallet, so both ask before they run.
estimateHint: Choose a plan and the usage to price.
usageChargeHint: Prices the customer's not-yet-rated usage in the period and charges the wallet. Repeating it returns the earlier result.
reservationHint: Holds an amount on the wallet until it is captured or released.
confirmChargeHint: The wallet is charged for the usage in this period. It cannot be undone here; refund the payment instead.
confirmReserveHint: The amount stays held on the wallet until the reservation is captured or released.
planHint: The latest version unless you pick one.
replayed: Already charged earlier; this is the earlier result.
